title: Hometown — mid (~6.5)
notes: Classic mid-band hometown sample; labels ~6.5 with GRA slightly lower.

turns.text: Let's talk about your hometown. Where do you live, and how long have you lived there?
I come from a small coastal town. I have lived there for most of my life, although I moved to the city for university three years ago.
What is your hometown famous for?
It is famous for its seafood and friendly people. In summer, many visitors come for the beach festivals.
Would you recommend it to a visitor?
Yes, especially if they enjoy walking by the sea. I enjoy practising English with travellers when I go back, which helps me stay motivated.
